_comment: Release contract for the runtime chat-model downloader (client/supervisor/model-downloader.js + model-catalog.js). sha256 + sizeBytes below are PINNED to the exact bytes HuggingFace served (git-LFS pointer, 2026-07-13); model-catalog.js carries the same pinned values. validateCatalogEntry() refuses placeholder/all-zero sha256, non-https url, and path-traversal filenames. Enterprise is still a placeholder because Qwen3.5-122B-A10B is not published at that path -- pin a real large model (or drop the tier) before enterprise chat can run locally.

embedModel._comment: Bundled into the .dmg (always local, never downloaded at runtime). Pinned here in one place for the bundler + any future 'verify what shipped' tooling.

enterprise._comment: TODO: Qwen3.5-122B-A10B-Q4_K_M.gguf is not published at this path. Pin a real large model or drop the tier. Rejects -> relay until then.
